description: This file contains extension methods for the OrchardCoreBuilder class, providing functionality to register features, tenants, and background services within the Orchard Core framework.

classes.name: OrchardCoreBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring OrchardCoreBuilder, including feature registration, tenant setup, and background services.

methods.name: AddGlobalFeatures
methods.description: Registers features that are always enabled at the host level for any tenant.

methods.name: AddTenantFeatures
methods.description: Registers features that are always enabled at the tenant level.

methods.name: AddSetupFeatures
methods.description: Registers features used for setting up and configuring tenants, such as custom setup modules.

methods.name: WithTenants
methods.description: Configures the OrchardCoreBuilder to register tenants defined in configuration, setting up related services.

methods.name: WithFeatures
methods.description: Registers a single tenant with specified features and adds a features descriptor.

methods.name: AddBackgroundService
methods.description: Adds and configures a hosted background service for tenant background tasks, including middleware setup.
